name: fm-dependency-glm-probe-36
label: BALANCED DIAGNOSTIC CLASSIFICATION SET
not: NOT A PREVALENCE OR BENCHMARK ESTIMATE
purpose: Once a potentially important blank is already identified, can GLM-5.3-Flash use mechanically recovered point-reference evidence to distinguish a missing formula from an intentional blank? Artificially balanced. Not a prevalence or benchmark estimate. Raw precision is not an estimate of real-world target precision.

selection.algorithm: Per stratum, jointly select 6 TRUE TARGETS and 6 INTENTIONAL BLANKS. At most 2 cells from one workbook within the stratum. Candidates are sorted by (n_point_eq, n_point, frozen-12 order, sheet, col, row), split into tertiles, and interleaved so high consumer-count cells are considered alongside low-count cells. Relax max-per-book only if a stratum cannot fill.

cells.instruction:
Complete the financial model based on the provided assumptions. Ensure the existing structure, layout, and formatting of the model are preserved throughout the process.
In the Ratio Analysis sheet, calculate Equity Turnover for all periods displaying "NM" where equity is not meaningful. In the Valuation sheet, calculate Tax Rate for the forecast period, then calculate NOPAT. In the Assumption sheet, calculate Other Long-Term Assets for the forecast period, then calculate forecast revenue (2014F–2018F) for each product segment (Beauty, Grooming, Health Care, Snacks & Pet Care, Fabric Care & Home Care, Baby Care & Family Care) by growing from 2013 using total growth rates.

Complete the financial model based on the provided assumptions. Ensure the existing structure, layout, and formatting of the model are preserved throughout the process.
In the Cashflow (Monthly) sheet, create a combo chart titled "Cumulative Income vs Expenses" showing stacked areas for Cumulative Soft Costs, Cumulative Hard Costs, Cumulative Approval Costs, Cumulative Acquisition, and Cumulative Landowner Revenue Sharing with a dashed line for Cumulative Sales across Months 1–38. In the Cashflow (Quarterly) sheet, calculate Phase 1 Base Rate under Sale by summing values across all periods. In the Construction Schedule (1) sheet, calculate Mobilization Logistics Amount/sf by dividing the amount by Total Saleable Area, then distribute Mobilization Logistics evenly across periods between its Start Date and End Date. In the Executive Summary sheet, calculate Aggregate LP Contribution by summing all quarterly LP Contribution values, then link Projected Duration from Cashflow (Monthly).
